name: treant heart
lore_descriptor: warm green-brown, still living, faintly growing at the grain
first_pickup_chronicle: Treant heart. Cut from the heart of a treant who was already dying — the wood is still alive. Bows of it draw stronger; staves of it root themselves in the floor when set down.
design_notes: Light-ench exotic_organic, pf 72. Mult 1.35, weight 0.9, enchant 5. Living-wood/regrowing flavor. Fills the late-band organic gap below worldtree.
